==Location Description== With [[Aelita]], [[Cella|Eldest]], and either [[Reina]], [[Kreiss]] or [[Adam]] and [[Delpha|Braixen]] in tow, the protagonist chases after [[Cera]] in order to stop her from obtaining the Earth Heart and unthawing [[Angie]]. If you chose either Reina or Kreiss as the partner, 2 puzzles would have to be solved, and if Adam was chosen, 2 ancient escavalier statues would instead be fought, the second one copying Adam's current team. After defeating the ancient mechanisms or solving the puzzles, the protagonist encounters a Team Xen grunt named Tommen, who fell into the Garufa Sanctuary about 1.5 months ago during the initial incidents at [[Carotos Mountain]] and was responsible for the notes left in the [[Corrupted Cave (Location)|Corrupted Cave]]. After defeating Tommen in battle, the grunt assists in unlocking the path forward. The Eldest would then lead the protagonist into the final room, where they encounter Cera, who awakens Groudon. After the battle with Behemoth Groudon, the protagonist finds Aelita unconscious, her heart having been blocked by Garufan curse. Tommen enters the scene and is blamed for Aelita's circumstances; realizing his error in failing to remember something written in the ancient books, he flees. Adam, Kreiss or Reina and the protagonist give chase, cornering him in the Corrupted Cave, where he meets an unfortunate end—what Team Xen refers to as "Termination." {{Spoilerbox}} Note: The energy crystals in this location can only be activated to start the [[Vivian's Regret]] quest during [[.Karma Files]]. They then show scenes of [[Vivian]]'s training before entering into the world above. {{SpoilerEnd}} ==Items== {{Itemlisth|cave}} {{Itemlist|Zoroark Crest|In the room with Hisuian Zorua in Cubi Excellus}} {{Itemlist|TM Grass|In the room with the bed shaped shadow. Requires a Dragon Type Pokemon in the party to open a door.|display=TM86 {{MoveIP|Grass Knot}}}} {{Itemlistfoot|cave}}
==Pokémon== The biggest statue puzzle in Cubi Excellus opens a door to a room with a [[Zorua|Hisuian Zorua]] and the [[Zoroark Crest]]. During [[.Karma Files]], it's possible to do the [[Vivian's Regret]] quest and obtain a [[Regirock]]. After capturing this particular Zorua, more Hisuian Zorua will appear in [[Evergreen Forest]]. {{Catch/header|cave|Special}} {{catch/entry|570H|Zorua|Hisuian|Interact|30|all=One|type1=Normal|type2=Ghost}} {{catch/entry|377|Regirock||Special|90|all=One|type1=Rock}} {{Catch/footer|cave}}
